person_note: The novel sustains two base-narration persons: Marcellus's recurring captivity sections are participating first person, while the Tova, Cameron, and other human-centered sections are third-person limited. The Goodreads evidence repeatedly contains both Marcellus's I-narration and extended third-person human scenes, and the authorized opening extract displays the same switch directly. Whole-book and chapter-level web descriptions corroborate that structure. Gnomic observations, dialogue, universal you/we, and clipped bare-pronoun passages were not promoted to book-level evidence. No credible second-person strand or unresolved structural conflict was found.
